name.ja: トイ・ストーリー4 ウッディ

ja: 映画『トイ・ストーリー4』より、「カウボーイ人形」ウッディが登場！
• 顔は細やかな分割で瞳や口内まで再現。表情変更パーツは充実の３種類！色分けは成形色で再現し、裏側から触ることで目線の変更も可能。
• ベストは多層構造。パーツの色分けにより、シール無しで牛柄を再現！
• ボタンやシェリフバッジも別パーツにすることで、よりリアルに！
• シャツの柄は深めのモールドによって自然な陰影が付き、チェック柄を表現。パーツの分割ラインをシャツの柄に合わせることで分割線が目立たず自然な仕上がりに。
• ハンドパーツは左右各４種類付属し、様々なポージングを演出。
• 靴底に貼れるシールが２種類付属。
en: From the movie "Toy Story 4 " comes the " cowboy doll" Woody!

• The face is recreated with detailed divisions, including the eyes and mouth. There are 3 types of expression changing parts! The color coding is reproduced with molded colors, and you can change the perspective by touching it from the back side.
• The vest has a multi-layer structure. By color-coding the parts, you can reproduce the cow pattern without seals!
• The buttons and sheriff badge are also made into separate parts to make it more realistic!

• The pattern of the shirt has natural shading due to the deep molding, creating a checkered pattern. By matching the parting lines of the parts to the pattern of the shirt, the parting lines are less noticeable and create a natural finish.
• Four types of hand parts are included for each side, allowing you to create a variety of poses.
• Two types of seals that can be attached to the soles of the shoes are included.

ja: ハンドパーツ×右2種左3種
en: Hand parts x 2 types on the right, 3 types on the left
